title: The Maratha Advance Into Gujarat And Malwa
definition: The strategic expansion of the Maratha Empire under the Peshwas (primarily Baji Rao I) into the Mughal provinces of Gujarat and Malwa during the early 18th century, transitioning from predatory raids to formal administrative control.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is critical for understanding the decline of the Mughal Empire, the shift in power dynamics from the Deccan to North India, and the evolution of Maratha fiscal systems (Chauth and Sardeshmukhi).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of The Maratha Advance Into Gujarat And Malwa.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
